text:
Renee Lopez: Heads-up: Candidate Jonas Meyer (Frontend) requested ASL interpreter and extra breaks for interviews due to hearing impairment. Also asked for captions on Zoom.
Harper (Recruiter): Candidate available Tue/Wed next week, prefers morning CET. Asked whether we can provide interpreter and extended time for whiteboard.
Diego: We have an approved vendor for ASL. Need 5 business days lead to book an interpreter. Which times exactly?
Marta (Hiring Manager): Panel is mostly EMEA so mornings CET fine. Proposed 2027-03-09 09:30 CET (60m loop). Jonas requested a 15m break between interviews and additional 20% time for live coding.
Renee Lopez: Policy: accommodations are provided; document request and accommodations plan in candidate file. Harper, please confirm written consent to share accommodation needs with panel and vendor.
Harper (Recruiter): Candidate consent received 2027-03-01 10:05 CET. I'll upload to the candidate record.
Access Services Bot: Reminder: Interpreter bookings require candidate consent + booking form submitted. Vendor: SignNowPro. Lead time: 5 business days. Booking URL: https://redwood/internal/access-services.
Diego: I'll submit booking now. Need exact meeting link, session length, and whether interpreter should be on-site or remote. Jonas prefers remote ASL interpreter via video (not on site).
Marta (Hiring Manager): Remote is fine. Also please enable live captions and record captions file. IT Ops 1: can we enable live captions & automated transcript in Zoom and also pin interpreter feed?
IT Ops: Yes. For Zoom we enable live transcription and spotlight the interpreter. Also will set meeting to allow closed captions and save transcript to secure storage. Will need the meeting host to enable captions.
Facilities: If candidate ever decides to come onsite, we can book a private quiet room with good lighting and camera for interpreter visibility. Note taken.
Renee Lopez: Also important: adjust evaluation rubric to account for extended time and use of interpreter. Marta, please confirm rubrics and debrief guidance.
Marta (Hiring Manager): Will update rubric: emphasize problem understanding, architecture choices, and communication over raw typing speed. Add 20% time allowance to timeboxed exercises.
Harper (Recruiter): Submitted SignNowPro booking form with: Tue 2027-03-09 09:30 CET, 90m session (60m interview + 15m break + 15m buffer), remote interpreter, timezone CET. Booking ref: SN-2027-332.
Interpreter Vendor: Booking received. Assigned interpreter: Lina P. We'll join 10m early to test AV. Confirmation email sent to candidate and host.
Diego: Please run a tech check 30m prior to confirm interpreter video quality and pinning. I'll create a tech-check calendar 30m before the session and invite interpreter + host + candidate.
Harper (Recruiter): Tech-check invite sent for 2027-03-09 09:00 CET. Candidate confirmed she can join the tech check.
IT Ops: Also provisioning note: provide live-caption fallback in case Zoom transcription fails. We'll enable Otter.ai integration as backup.
Renee Lopez: Good. Also ensure we provide accessible candidate packet: alt text on images, plain-text transcripts, and a short note on interview flow. Harper, include that in the invite.
Harper (Recruiter): Done. Invite updated with accommodations summary: ASL interpreter remote, 15m break, 20% extra time, captions enabled, tech-check at 09:00 CET. Candidate replied: "Thank you, that works. Appreciate the break & interpreter arrangements." :heart:
Marta (Hiring Manager): Panel please note adjusted times: interview 09:30-10:30 CET with break at 09:55-10:10 CET. I'll ask panel to join 5m early for brief on accommodations.
Diego: LOANER not required; candidate will use personal machine. One IT note: ensure interpreter has secure join token and meeting password. I'll add to host settings.
Interpreter Vendor: Can confirm we'll join at 09:00 CET for AV test and be on standby. Please provide any specific sign-language glossaries (technical terms) 48h before session.
Marta (Hiring Manager): I'll attach a short glossary for our stack (React, Webpack, GraphQL, SSR) to the vendor note.
Access Services Bot: Accessibility checklist: consent on file, vendor booked SN-2027-332, captions enabled, tech-check scheduled, rubric adjusted. All items green except post-interview feedback guidance.
Renee Lopez: After interview, we'll run an accommodations debrief: candidate experience + panel notes on rubric fairness. Harper, please send candidate follow-up survey link.
Harper (Recruiter): Follow-up survey link included in thank-you note. Panel reminder: submit feedback within 48h and use adjusted rubric.
Marta (Hiring Manager): Thanks team. Appreciate the quick coordination.
Renee Lopez: Nice work. Logging this thread to candidate record and to our access-services monthly report.
